purpose: Scientific type routing for legacy fixed-star labels that refer to clusters/nebular regions, not individual Hipparcos stars. These are NOT ready-to-compute positions.
sources: NASA Science and CDS SIMBAD for astronomical type; legacy label mapping is a separately reviewed application concern

objects.name: Aculeus
objects.review: Butterfly Cluster: cluster-centre coordinates must be defined separately from any member star; no HIP ID inferred

objects.name: Acumen
objects.review: Ptolemy's Cluster: requires explicit centre/epoch and angular-extent policy; no member-star substitution

objects.name: Facies
objects.review: M22 traditional Facies association must be reviewed separately; cluster centre rather than member-star 6D state

objects.name: Praesepe
objects.review: Beehive Cluster/Praesepe is an extended open cluster; select an explicit astrometric centre

objects.name: Spiculum
objects.review: Traditional Spiculum may refer to a complex around M8, M20 and M21; M8 is a nebula, not a unique stellar point; do not infer one-to-one HIP or unique centre
